name: Hagi (Japan)
description: A white field charged with the Hagi city emblem: a large blue lattice of crossed diagonal bands filling the field.
history: Municipal flag of Hagi, a city in Yamaguchi Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 12 November 2005.

features.role: Hagi city emblem — a large lattice of crossed diagonal bands filling the field
